RECORD SUMMARY -- U.S. Food and Drug Administration public record 63059

Record type: FDA device recall record
Company named in the record: Baxter
Product named in the record: Baxter Interlink System Buretrol Solution Set with 150 mL Burette (Ball-Valve Drip Chamber); a sterile Rx IV fluid pathway device. Product U

Declared fields
- Record identifier: 63059
- Decision / event date: 2012-09-07
- Applicant / firm as recorded: Baxter
- Device or product as recorded: Baxter Interlink System Buretrol Solution Set with 150 mL Burette (Ball-Valve Drip Chamber); a sterile Rx IV fluid pathway device. Product U
- Advisory committee: not stated
- Decision description: not stated
- Country of applicant: not stated
- Product code: FPA
- Device class: Z-0012-2013

Additional notes recorded with this entry
- Reason or context as recorded: Baxter has determined that the ball-valve feature of the Buretrol Solution Sets may not function as expected, allowing air to flow past the valve and into the tubing at the completion of dose within the burette.
- Distribution as recorded: Worldwide Distribution - US Nationwide and Internationally to Canada, Costa Rica, Australia, New Zealand, Hong Kong, and

This summary reproduces fields declared by the source record and adds no new
facts. Any interpretation of these fields is the reader's own.
